goal: Is ke baad aap selection sort se array sort kar sakte hain, usay pass ba pass trace kar sakte hain, aur samjha sakte hain ke yeh bubble sort se kaise alag hai (har pass mein ek swap, N - 1 passes).
warmup: Socho ek teacher subah ki assembly ke liye 5 students ko chhote se lambe ki line mein khara kar rahi hain. Woh baar baar aas paas walon ko swap nahi karti. Woh un SAB students ko dekhti hain jo abhi tak apni jagah par nahi hain, sab se chhote ko chun leti hain, aur us student ko line ke aage kar deti hain. Phir woh baaki ko dekhti hain, dobara sab se chhote ko chunti hain, aur usay doosri jagah par rakh deti hain. Woh pehle chunti hain, phir hatati hain. Yehi selection sort hai.
definition: Selection sort array ke elements ko order mein lagane (sorting) ka ek tareeqa hai. Har pass mein yeh us hisse ka sab se chhota element dhoondta hai jo abhi tak unsorted hai aur usay us hisse ke pehle element se swap kar deta hai. Pass 1 ke baad sab se chhoti value index 0 par hoti hai. Pass 2 ke baad doosri sab se chhoti index 1 par hoti hai, aur isi tarah. Ascending ka matlab chhote se bara; descending ka matlab bare se chhota.
howItWorks: Array do hisson mein bata hota hai: aage ek sorted hissa (shuru mein khaali) aur ek unsorted hissa (baaki sab). Har pass mein: (1) maan lein ke pehla unsorted element sab se chhota hai aur uska INDEX minIdx naam ke variable mein likh lein; (2) unsorted hisse ke baaki ko scan karein, aur jab bhi koi chhoti value mile, minIdx update karein; scan ke dauran swap NAHI karte; (3) scan khatam hone par a[i] ko a[minIdx] se swap karein. Yeh har pass mein EK swap hai. Sorted hissa ek element se barh jata hai. N elements ke liye N - 1 passes chahiye, kyun ke aakhri element khud ba khud sahi jagah par hota hai. Comparisons ki tadad N = 5 ke liye 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 10 hai, aam taur par N(N-1)/2, aur yeh tab bhi nahi badalti jab data pehle se sorted ho. Swaps ziyada se ziyada N - 1 hote hain, jo bubble sort ke aam swaps se kahin kam hain. Descending order ke liye sab se bari value dhoondein: < ko > se badal dein.
